title: Patch 21 - Instrument Comprehension Integration
description: Adds Instrument Comprehension as a full AFOQT subject with instrument panel questions testing attitude, heading, and climb/descent interpretation.

mappedGameSubtopics.description: Reading bank, pitch, and heading from artificial horizon and compass instruments.
Advanced gauge interpretation with multiple instruments including climb/descent indicators.

inferenceNotesForCopilot: Infer difficulty level from the filename: 'instrument_comprehension_beginner_part1.json' → difficulty=beginner.
Each JSON file contains questions with instrument_panel uiSpec showing attitude indicator and heading indicator.
Choices are image-based (aircraft silhouettes) with only one matching all three parameters: bank, pitch, and heading.

questionRoutingRules: 2. Each JSON contains questions with uiSpec type 'instrument_panel'.
3. Aggregate questions into registry by difficulty: questions['instrument_comprehension']['basic_attitude_and_heading'][difficulty].
4. Randomly select questions for practice tests ensuring variety of attitudes (level, climbing, descending, banking left/right).
uiIntegration: Use instrument_panel uiSpec to render attitude indicator (artificial horizon) and heading indicator (compass).
Display four aircraft image choices (A-D) where only one matches all instrument readings.
In practice test mode, hide explanations until section is complete.
Follow AFOQT/Trivium style: instruments on top/left, aircraft choices as selectable images below/right.
implementationNotes: Instrument panel questions test ability to read pitch (climb/level/descend), bank (left/right/level), and heading (0-359 degrees).
Choice A is typically correct by construction; distractors B, C, D each differ in exactly one parameter.
Questions use 'IMAGE' placeholder in choices text; actual rendering driven by choiceSprites in uiSpec.
Ensure frontend IC component properly interprets artificialHorizon, compass, and choiceSprites fields.
Generator-based approach maintains consistency across beginner/advanced/expert levels.

validationRules.uiSpecRequired: All IC questions must have uiSpec with type='instrument_panel'
validationRules.choiceFormat: Choices must reference image sprites via choiceSprites in uiSpec
validationRules.correctAnswerConstruction: Choice A should match all instrument readings exactly; B/C/D differ by one parameter each
validationRules.timingGuidance: 12 seconds per question average for full AFOQT simulation
